**Checklist**
- [ ] A failing test came first, and `swift test --package-path Packages/SouffleurKit` passes
- [ ] `node site/tools/audit.mjs` is clean if `site/` changed
- [ ] The promises in CONTRIBUTING.md still hold (idle means idle, the voice stays on the Mac, no network but Sparkle and the remote you turn on)
- [ ] Visible text is in English, in the String Catalog when it is in the app, and has no em dash
